Steps from that session

    

    
A landscape that reads your face

    
Moodscape

    
Your front camera reads your smile, brows, eyes and mouth. A small image model on your phone paints a new landscape to match how you look.

    
    
    
It also learns from you. For a couple of seconds after each new painting it watches how your face reacts, then drifts toward the styles and layouts you respond to. Your taste profile stays on this phone.

    
Smile for a golden meadow. Widen your eyes for an aurora. Scowl for a volcanic storm. Frown for rain. Close your eyes for a few seconds to bring night. Face tracking and painting both run on your phone; no video or images leave it.
